title_zh: 李娜：第一位获得大满贯的亚洲球员
title_en: Famous Chinese People (4/20): Li Na, Asia's First Grand Slam Champion
note_en: Chinese verbs don't change for tense, so 了 (le) after a verb marks a completed action: 职业生涯一共获得了两个大满贯冠军 "she won two Grand Slam titles in her career." 曾 (céng) does a related job before the verb, meaning "once, at some point in the past": 她曾两次饮恨决赛 "she had twice suffered heartbreak in the final." English shows all this with -ed or "had"; Chinese uses these small words plus dates like 2011年.
